title: Medical genetics
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Apply inheritance patterns and pedigree risk, chromosomal and repeat-expansion disorders, imprinting, mitochondrial and population genetics, genetic testing and screening, cancer genetics, pharmacogenomics, common syndromes, counseling and ethics.

blocks.deliverable: Calculate the risk for a child in a supplied pedigree.
Explain anticipation in Huntington disease and fragile X syndrome.
Use the Hardy–Weinberg equation for carrier screening.
Week 7 midterm; compare karyotype, microarray and sequencing.
Explain BRCA testing and a drug–gene interaction such as CYP2C19 with clopidogrel.
Role-play disclosure of a genetic result.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Genetic counseling simulation: work up a supplied family history, choose tests, interpret a result, and write the counseling summary.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
